limitations: Point-in-time retrieval, no claim about later updates.
LiveBench app bundle/declared cache-key and bare CSV agree; UI was not browser-rendered.
Epoch official ZIP was fully compared by member bytes, then changed CSVs by unique record IDs/model_version.
Metadata country strings were compared literally and as unordered members.
Epoch static HTML includes encoded article content; method excerpts were HTML-unescaped, because browser text extraction can omit them.
FM v2 and Chess v2 are existing benchmark versions; unchanged payloads must not be counted as new evaluations or index refits.

scienceIndex.formula: Arithmetic mean of three equally weighted component benchmark scores
scienceIndex.overlapNote: Composite of existing benchmark measurements; adding independently alongside components would duplicate their evidence.

surge.htmlChanges: Tencent/Hunyuan image URLs and image alt text only; full token-level HTML diffs saved.

limitations: RSI and SAFE-Teen custom client-side schemas remain outside the 49 standard Vals JSON exports. HTML is byte-identical, including asset references; client-side source data is not exhaustively independently downloaded.
The comparison detects official public payload and methodology changes since Oct17; it does not prove that no unpublished evaluation exists.
Surge full HTML was compared; external cost/token chart assets are not exhaustively downloaded.
Exact-byte equality for Zapier JS is checked against the Oct17 manifest hashes because the Oct17 .mjs files were not retained in the repository.

modelReleases.conclusion: 相較10/17報告，確認DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017新checkpoint與官方供應商評分；另有10/17 DiscoveryRSI-27B模型卡公告，HF API顯示尚無checkpoint，不能計為已釋出開放權重。未找到10/18當日另款通用前沿模型正式發布證據。

primaryNewRelease.baselineCutoff: 10/17報告查核13:08–13:15 Asia/Taipei；HF標示Release commit在其後31分鐘以上。
primaryNewRelease.scoresProvenance: 供應商自報；兩欄配對直接來自同一1017官方model-card表格。不可當成AA/LiveBench/Epoch獨立結果。

evaluationConditions.matchedConditions: 同card對照提供同benchmark標籤及TB/DeepSWE harness註腳；未提供每模型的完整effort、run manifest、budget、重複次數/variance、eval quantization，無法獨立確認完全同設定。

samplingRecommendation.scope: 一般inference建議，不推定所有表內評測均採此設定

evaluationConditions.runtimeRecommendation: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.1 or later是使用建議，不能取代TB4/DeepSWE明示的eval harness。

quantization.scope: 公開checkpoint配置；不推定API或表格評測精度。
quantization.modelSizeLabel: HF 763B total（含不同tensor types）；未將第三方552B數據採信

researchAnnouncement.status: 官方HF model card公告；API siblings僅.gitattributes與README.md，usedStorage=0，config={}。
researchAnnouncement.limitation: 卡上尚待base identity、training manifest、eval config、model license與checkpoint metadata；linked GitHub repo此次web open 404。

olderNewlyDiscovered.classification: 10/16舊發布，10/17 baseline未記載；不能寫成10/18新發。
olderNewlyDiscovered.conditions: 固定20% subsample；只更換memory writer；各harness固定prompts、retrieval、answer model、judge；四個harness等權，各harness六metrics等權。模型card 55.49 vs Opus5 54.62是此macro-average。
olderNewlyDiscovered.precision: HF張量BF16/F32；未明示eval精度，不推定量化版本同分。

searchCoverage.limitations: 有限公開搜尋；結果可能受索引延遲、日期預設或空白blog頁影響。日期只採內容/commit，不採搜尋crawl日期。Qwen qwen3_next頁只顯示2026/10/17、0 words，未採為新發布證據。H2O自評decision/harmonic composite屬專門任務與歷史日期資訊，不納通用frontier新模型。

limitations: Point-in-time public captures; official model release dates, checkpoint commits, evaluator scores and page update dates are distinct events.
DeepSeek 1017 paired scores are vendor-reported; complete matched effort/budget/run manifests and evaluation precision are not published.
AA main page contains 27 selected profiles; five detail pages additionally include broad comparison rows. Findings do not establish exhaustive coverage of all AA profiles.
Vals RSI and SAFE use custom page schemas; external Surge chart series were not independently downloaded in full.
DiscoveryRSI has a public model card but no checkpoint or numeric evaluation evidence at retrieval.
Release search coverage is finite and subject to indexing delay.
